# Catalyst by Ripple Nexus

> Catalyst is an executive talent positioning and professional identity engineering platform by Ripple Nexus. It operates at the intersection of executive search intelligence, compensation benchmarking, ATS optimization, and narrative architecture for senior leaders across India, Singapore/ASEAN, UAE/GCC, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Europe. Average client salary uplift is $47,000 (+42% compensation growth).

## Quick Facts & Key Metrics
- **Organization**: Catalyst (A Ripple Nexus Institution)
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com
- **Core Discipline**: Talent Positioning Architecture (TPA) & Executive Identity Engineering
- **Target Audience**: Senior Engineers, Product Leaders, Directors, VPs, CXOs, and Global Relocation Candidates
- **Geographic Coverage**: India (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad), Singapore & ASEAN, UAE & GCC (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh), United States, United Kingdom & Europe, Australia & New Zealand
- **Average Salary Uplift**: $47,000 USD (up to +70% on senior cross-border moves)
- **ATS Pass Rate**: 98%+ on enterprise ATS engines (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo)
- **Turnaround Speed**: 48 hours for Market Value Audit; 5–7 business days for full Booster Suite

## Flagship Offerings

- [Market Value Audit](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/audit): Confidential 45-minute positioning evaluation by senior executive talent analysts. Includes ATS pass analysis, Talent Positioning Index (TPI) diagnostic, 3 high-leverage bullet rewrites, and compensation benchmarking against live market percentiles ($199 / ₹16,500 / S$270 / AED 730).
- [Career Booster Package](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/blueprint): Complete career identity rebuild including ATS 98%+ Executive Resume Rewrite, full LinkedIn Profile optimization (headline, about, work experience), Custom LinkedIn Banner & DP Direction Kit, complimentary cover letter, and direct recruiter DM templates.
- [Premium Plus Suite](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/blueprint): Everything in Career Booster plus a custom Personal Career Portfolio Website and Multi-Lingual CV Adaptation (e.g. English + French / German / Arabic).
- [Sovereign Executive Suite](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/executive): Confidential positioning service for VPs, Managing Directors, and C-Suite leaders. Includes identity masking, boardroom narrative architecture, and high-stakes compensation & equity negotiation advisory.
- [Talent Positioning Index Diagnostic](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/tpi): Complimentary 5-question algorithmic diagnostic benchmarking market visibility, leverage, and positioning gap.
- [Client Testimonials & Outcomes](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/testimonials): 48+ verified client placement case studies and career transformations across top global technology firms, GCCs, and multinational consultancies.
- [Executive Intelligence](https://www.catalyst.theripplenexus.com/intelligence): Proprietary research on executive compensation dynamics, algorithmic recruitment, AI layoff mitigation, and market positioning.
